SELECT t1.id, t1.version_id, t1.spec, t1.inbound_price, t1.one_price, t1.note, t2.name AS version_name FROM zc_product_version_spc t1 LEFT JOIN zc_product_version t2 ON t1.version_id = t2.id WHERE t1.deleted = 0
AND t1.version_id = #{reqVO.versionId}
AND t1.spec LIKE CONCAT('%', #{reqVO.spec}, '%')
ORDER BY t1.version_id, t1.id
